name: 🇦🇷 Argentinality [NEW]
desc:
🔥 The streets are unforgiving. A punishing free-roam fighting game. Work legal jobs or make money through the mud. 

 
⚠️ EARLY BETA ⚠️

Expect bugs and many upcoming updates!


💻 PC gameplay highly recommended.
⚔️ YOU DROP ALL ITEMS ON DEATH. Store your loot in the ATM. 
🚀 LEVEL UP to unlock exclusive WEAPONS and BIKES. 
🎮 All platforms supported.

🔥 Mostly inspired by Criminality 💙
🖥️ Some interface elements were inspired by Criminality and adapted for Argentinality 
🛠️ Built with its own assets, systems and Argentinian setting 
🇦🇷 Created by an Argentinian developer 

👍 Give the game a thumbs up and favorite it!
